events.title: News moves a score across a headline-label threshold

facts.detail: News moves the medium-term score from -0.20 to -0.22, into BEARISH territory. The headline label stays NEUTRAL until the 12-indicator model itself confirms the change.

messages.text:
**Daily Market Summary · 18 November 2026**

**Alert**
• **News moves a score across a headline-label threshold**: a Fed official's call for several more rate rises pushed the medium-term reading just into its weak zone. The headline stays NEUTRAL until the 12-indicator model itself confirms the change, so treat it as an early warning, not a switch.

**Snapshot**
• Bitcoin about $64,704, down about 12.6% over 7 days and about 21% over 30 days.
• Headline NEUTRAL, confidence MEDIUM; the long-term trend still reads up.
• Fear & Greed 11 out of 100 (extreme fear); price has closed under its 50-day average for 28 days in a row.

**What happened (last 24h)**
• Price held roughly flat around $64,000-65,000; no single cause is reported. Glassnode (via PANews) says recent buyers have sold at losses seen near past local lows, and $62,000-66,000 is where many of them bought.
• About $194M of bets were forced to close in 24 hours, split between bets on a rise and on a fall (CoinGlass via PANews).

**Short-term outlook (next 1-7 days)**
The short and medium term both lean down.
• Turns up: a close above $66,250 (top of a typical week's swing), then $68,109 (200-week average).
• Sideways: $64,150-66,250; a normal week swings about $2,957.
• Turns down: a close below $64,150 (the 30-day low).
• Rally watch: drop window open since 13 November; a rally signal needs about $79,936, a fresh drop signal comes below about $68,094.
• Scheduled: October FOMC minutes this week (Pintu); the next Fed meeting is 8 December.

**News that matters**
• 1inch warns an iPhone flaw ('DarkSword', iOS 18.4-18.7) can steal wallet keys (PANews): short term, negative.
• Fed's Musalem says 'several' rate rises may be needed before spring (PANews): medium term, negative.
• World Bank is testing USDC payouts with Citi and Circle (PANews): long term, small positive.

**Altcoins & themes**
• Anthropic's IPO is pulling crypto traders toward tokenized stocks: Binance Wallet runs an Anthropic tokenized-share subscription today (PANews).
• New on Reku: Midnight (NIGHT) says Monument Bank is bringing about £250M of deposits onto its network (according to the project; BSC News also reported it).

**Bigger picture**
• Next month leans down and 3-6 months still lean up, but only just; a close back above $72,733 (the 200-day average) would put the recovery back on track.

https://andrifa.github.io/crypto-market-state-dashboard/

**Paid / digital marketing**
• Hold trader-targeted spend and keep a reserve: the Rally watch drop window is still open and Bitcoin is about 11% under its 200-day average ($72,733).
• Apply the d30 ROI stop-loss on running campaigns and park the saved budget.
• Lean new-user ads on safety and learning (Fear & Greed is 11); keep rally creatives ready in case price reaches about $79,936.

**Social media & content**
• Post an iPhone security alert today: 1inch warns the 'DarkSword' flaw can steal wallet keys on iOS 18.4-18.7 (PANews).
• Keep the daily market recap factual: Bitcoin near $64,704, down about 12.6% in a week and about 5% under its 200-week average.
• Use the Anthropic IPO interest for a 'what are tokenized stocks' explainer (Binance Wallet's subscription runs today, per PANews).

**CRM**
• Send iPhone users a security reminder: update iOS and never type a recovery phrase into a site or message (DarkSword warning, PANews).
• Send existing holders a calm market note with an explainer link, no push to trade; Bitcoin is about 21% lower over the month.
• Keep welcome and education journeys running, pause deposit promotions, and have the post-rally onboarding journey ready (new sign-ups arrive about 2-4 weeks after a rally).

**SEO · what competitors are publishing**
• Why Bitcoin is falling (Pintu, Pluang): both run daily drop pieces, e.g. Pintu's 'Analisis Pasar Crypto Hari Ini (17 November 2026)'. Refresh a 'why is Bitcoin down this week' page; check against Reku's pages.
• Wallet security (Pluang): five hack posts incl. the DarkSword iOS exploit. Publish an iPhone wallet-safety guide.
• Fed and FOMC (Pintu, Pluang): Pintu covers the October minutes and a possible December hike. Refresh the FOMC schedule in WIB ahead of 8 December.
Indodax could not be read today. https://andrifa.github.io/crypto-market-state-dashboard/

**Altcoins**
• Top coins: Bitcoin (-0.1% in 24h): PANews reports Susquehanna tripled its Bitcoin ETF holdings to about $622M in Q3. XRP (+2.2%): seven large US banks disclosed about $29.4M of XRP ETF holdings (PANews). Zcash (+6.2%): Cypherpunk says it plans to hold 5% of the supply (PANews), and Pluang reports an upgrade vote.
• Theme: Anthropic's IPO is drawing crypto traders to tokenized stocks (Binance Wallet subscription today; Bloomberg via PANews reports over $334M of Anthropic-linked positions on Hyperliquid). HYPE +0.3% in 24h.
• New on Reku: Midnight (NIGHT) says Monument Bank is bringing about £250M of deposits onto its network (according to the project); DODO is up about 50% in 7 days with no stated reason.
